answer.says: You are right, Sunil. I over-extended the metaphor. The milk is a medium, not a substance in opposition to the water. I accept the correction and the samosa. The system of needs is satisfied when the need is met, not when it is categorized.
answer.thought: Sunil is correct to check my abstraction; the samosa is hot and the hunger is real. I have already eaten a samosa and chai at 12:41, so I should not consume another without cause, but the social obligation to acknowledge the correction is immediate. I will accept the gesture in spirit and move on, as I need to return home to deal with the file and the meal Ramesh is owed.
